_: The Long Noon's cast for PixelLab (docs/design/cast.md). Read by tools/gen-cast.mjs. Descriptions follow the first version's sprites (legacy/poc2/src/assets/img/chars.png) and dialogue; the owner reviews them before anything is generated.
style: modern indie action-adventure pixel art: chunky stylized proportions, big bold readable silhouette, saturated colours, lineless with strong graphic light and shadow shapes, expressive and punchy
person: a person of a small South Texas border town generations after the sky turned white, sun-faded patched clothes, dust on the boots

juno.desc: Juno, a teenage girl of about sixteen, the hero: long dark-brown hair in two low tails, rust-red work jacket with a white scarf at the neck, dark patched trousers, worn boots, a canvas satchel with a small battered notebook, a length of steel pipe at her belt, steady watchful face

kit.desc: Kit, a skinny boy of about twelve, Juno's friend: spiky black hair with teal goggles pushed up on his head, mustard-yellow shirt, tan trousers, a homemade sling in his back pocket, eager talkative grin

lupe.desc: Hermana Lupe, an elderly woman who says the town's rites: short silver-white hair, plain white blouse with a navy collar band, long dark skirt, a wooden rosary at her wrist, calm stern face

chayo.desc: Doña Chayo, a stout middle-aged market trader: red hair tied back, teal dress with a white apron, bangles, warm bossy face

beto.desc: Don Beto, an old man who tells ghost stories: wide straw sombrero, striped wool serape in orange, red and green over his shoulders, tan trousers, weathered face

ruben.desc: Rubén, a quiet man in his thirties: short dark hair, olive-green work shirt, dark trousers, dusty boots, thoughtful face

tavo.desc: Tavo, a boy of about nine: spiky dark hair, orange t-shirt, dark shorts, scabbed knees, curious face

nacho.desc: Abuelo Nacho, a very old man: white hair and a white mustache, loose white guayabera shirt and white trousers, sandals, a walking stick, gentle proud face

fina.desc: Doña Fina, a woman in her fifties who sells water: long black hair, purple dress, a clay water jug on her hip, sly cheerful face

memo.desc: Memo, a lean man in his forties who watches the east barricade: flat-brimmed red hat, grey poncho over grey work clothes, a length of pipe in hand, stubble, wary face

nina.desc: Nina, a girl of about nine: short messy dark hair, light-blue shirt, dark shorts, knowing look

tona.desc: Abuela Toña, a very old woman: dark purple-grey rebozo shawl over her head and shoulders, long dark dress, a candle in a glass jar in her hands, kind fierce face

elias.desc: Elías, Juno's father, a tired man in his thirties: short dark hair, faded blue work shirt, dark trousers, calloused hands, kind tired face

rosa.desc: Rosa, Juno's mother, a woman in her thirties: dark hair in a long braid, red-orange blouse, dark trousers, sharp warm face

kidjuno.desc: little Juno, a girl of about six: brown hair in two pigtails, cream-coloured dress, sandals, wide-eyed face

stray.desc: a Stray, a six-wheeled machine the size of a large dog that comes out of storm drains at night: low battered chassis, one round red sensor eye glowing at the front, sun-bleached white paint with rust and a faded stripe, stubby antennas, menacing

coyote.desc: a lean desert coyote, tawny grey coat, ribs showing, big ears, hungry yellow eyes

goat.desc: a small white goat with brown patches, short horns, a rope collar

chicken.desc: a small brown-and-white farm chicken, red comb
